<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C13H9O), the presence of 12 aromatic carbons, and a single carbonyl group, the most plausible fragments are a phenyl ring and a benzoyl fragment (phenyl attached to a carbonyl). These two fragments can be joined to form the whole molecule. The SMILES strings for these fragments are "c1ccccc1" (phenyl) and "C(=O)c1ccccc1" (benzoyl).</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'C(=O)c1ccccc1']</final_answer>
